INSERT INTO notifications ( id, event_id, receiver_id, actor_id, latest_actor_id, type, target_type, target_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, title, content, extra_json, actor_count, read_status, create_time, update_time, read_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{eventId}, #{receiverId}, #{actorId}, #{latestActorId}, #{type}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{extraJson}, #{actorCount}, #{readStatus}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{readTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET event_id = #{eventId}, latest_actor_id = #{latestActorId}, actor_count = actor_count + 1, content = #{content}, extra_json = #{extraJson}, read_status = 0, update_time = #{updateTime}, create_time = #{updateTime}, read_time = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM notifications WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND read_status = 0
